## Goal
The monthly update and the printable report (E5) need "new since last time". `scan_exposure` keeps the previous result (`prev`, `exposure.py:601-602`) only to reuse a fresh answer. Add a pure `newly_found(previous, current) -> list[str]` to `exposure.py`: broker ids that are `found` with a confirmed match now, that were freshly read as `not_found` in the previous result, and that are fresh in both (neither entry `from_store` nor `check_by_hand`). Sorted by broker id. Additive; `scan_exposure`, `ExposureResult` and the stored event are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Table test: not_found then found-confirmed is listed; found then found is not; found then not_found is not; possible-only is not; check_by_hand on either side is not; `from_store` on either side is not.
2. A broker missing from the previous result is not listed (no baseline).
3. `previous=None` returns an empty list.
4. Output is sorted and de-duplicated; a result with duplicate entries for one broker uses the last one.
5. Works on results built with `ExposureEntry`/`ExposureResult` from `exposure_models.py` only; no store, no network.
6. WO-242/257/259/278 tests and the existing exposure tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
